title: W021.5 Telangana Assembly Constituency layer comparison

comparisonMethod.geometryConversion: ESRI rings converted to Polygon/MultiPolygon using ESRI clockwise exterior / counterclockwise hole convention.
comparisonMethod.invalidGeometryHandling: make_valid applied to derived in-memory copies only for cross-layer comparison; raw geometry files remain unchanged.
comparisonMethod.nameMatching: casefolded Assembly/ASSEMBLY_N; fuzzy name match for Jangaon/Jangoan; Madhira reservation suffix differs only by case.
comparisonMethod.thresholds: Near-identical means symmetric difference area < 0.01 m². No legal acceptance is inferred from geometric similarity.

topology.sharedInvalidFeature: Dornakal (ST) Assembly; same self-intersection location in both layers.

negligibleDifferences.name: Sirpur
negligibleDifferences.interpretation: Sub-millimetre precision difference; not treated as a material boundary shift.

decision: The three EndowmentLands service variants form one geometry family (Admin_New and Admin_2026 are byte-identical; Admin_Old differs only by sub-millimetre coordinate precision). The older AdministrativeInfoSystem layer is the outlier, with six material constituency geometry shifts relative to the new family. Prefer the new-family data as the leading Telangana candidate for statutory crosswalk and boundary validation, but do not mark it canonical until the ECI Schedule III/State Reorganisation effective-date chain, all-119 AC-number mapping, Dornakal repair, and authoritative state-boundary coverage tests pass.
requiredNextActions: Obtain service owner confirmation of which layer represents legally effective boundaries and its effective date.
Crosswalk all 119 names to official ECI statutory AC numbers and the applicable delimitation order/State reorganisation instruments.
Inspect official maps/order extents for Warangal East/West, Ibrahimpatnam, Munugode, Peddapalle, Manthani and Sirpur.
Repair Dornakal only in a separate derived candidate, preserve raw hashes and transformation history, and compare the union against an authoritative Telangana state boundary.
Do not import either layer into canonical production data before these gates pass.
Crosswalk all 119 state-GIS feature names to Schedule III AC numbers and compare the named disputed geometries against the order's mandal/municipal-ward extents.

legalReference.title: Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 2008
legalReference.schedule: Schedule III — Andhra Pradesh, Assembly Constituencies
legalReference.pages: PDF pages 8–16 for the named constituencies below
legalReference.note: The order enumerates Andhra Pradesh AC numbers and territorial extents. Telangana's current 119-seat set appears as AC numbers 1–119 in that schedule; final current-effectiveness must also reconcile the State Reorganisation instruments and any later effective Gazette/order.

layerFamilyAnalysis.adminOldUnionNote: Admin_Old's union reports two parts because the Bhadrachalam (ST) detached ring does not merge under its lower coordinate precision; the same ring exists in the other layers. Treat this as a precision/topology artifact pending normalization, not evidence of a different statutory boundary.
